commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the left side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and the keeper pulls off an easy save.
90+5' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

90+4' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Max Weiss was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+3' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90+1' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
